note: Lassen Volcanic's largest campground, in Jeffrey and ponderosa pine a short walk south-east of Manzanita Lake, a mile inside the northwest entrance. Pay showers at the camper store; the first loop is concession camping cabins. Park entrance fee extra. --Claude
summary: Manzanita Lake: $26 summer / $15 water-off (2027); 170 reservable sites (no first-come), max 14 nights; RVs to 40 ft per NPS (116 RV sites take 23 ft+); open May 28 to about Nov 1. Not waterfront kept (~290 m through forest). Pin ~700 m off the loops.
